integrity: All stated graphs and simplicial complexes are finite for fixed r; proofs apply uniformly to all integer r>=2. Finite checks corroborate without establishing the infinite theorem. The dihedral action is calculated on integral first homology, not claimed as an equivariant simplicial collapse of the original complex. No external independent mathematical validation was conducted.
limitations: Odd rims of length >=5 only; stable inclusion nullity uses the previously published ordinary wheel matching-complex theorem. Abstract cyclic-arc nerve topology and character were previously known; originality is confined to the wheel-specific identification and inclusion comparison. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Wheel perfect-matching circles and a sharp change in their inclusion into matching complexes
